action: Open General and a named space directly
user_goal: I want an Ask link to open the right space
preconditions: Fresh Ben Try it household
steps: Open Ask at /canvas
Use Memory → Spaces to create March paperwork
Open that space’s /canvas?space=<id> URL directly
Return to General, then Home
expected: General opens by default and shows starter canvases
The space selector says March paperwork and the new thread is empty
Returning to General restores its view
Home still shows ¥0 safe to spend and a ¥18,780 shortfall on Nov 27 if clients are late

action: Request the Ask view for the current household
user_goal: I want the view to return my selected space privately
preconditions: A household with General and a named space
steps: Run npm run db:ask-routes-test
Check the same-origin view with no space parameter and with the named space id
expected: Both responses return 200 with Cache-Control: private, no-store
The first view selects General and the second selects the named space

action: Request an Ask view without access
user_goal: I want only my household to be able to read my Ask spaces
preconditions: Two households with their own spaces
steps: Run npm run db:ask-routes-test
Check requests without a session, from a foreign origin, and with malformed, unknown or foreign space ids
expected: The missing session returns 401 and the foreign origin returns 403
Each invalid space lookup returns 404 without space data

action: Load an Ask view with kinds kept on this device
user_goal: I want my device-held thread, brief, notes and pins to stay on this device
preconditions: The household keeps its journal, memory and canvases on this device
steps: Run npm run db:ask-routes-test
Load a view for the selected space
expected: The view includes the space metadata and omits turns, briefs, notes and pins for device-held kinds

action: Reach the shared Ask view and canvas request limit
user_goal: I want the app to tell me when I should wait before retrying
preconditions: A household at its canvas request limit
steps: Run npm run db:ask-routes-test
Make a view request with the household’s canvas request bucket exhausted
expected: The view returns 429 for the shared 120 requests per minute household bucket

action: Render the same Ask view in both sizes
user_goal: I want the compact view to have the same Ask controls
preconditions: A named Ask space with a brief
steps: Run npm run db:ask-routes-test
Render the full and panel presentations from the same Ask view
expected: Both render the question form and space controls; the full page also renders the brief, notes and starter canvases
Only the panel renders Open full for the selected space, and it leaves out the brief, notes, delete control and starter canvases

action: Open the selected space in full Ask
user_goal: I want more room for the canvas in the space I am using
preconditions: A fresh Ben Try it household with a named space March paperwork
steps: At 1440px open the Ask panel from Home
Select March paperwork
Ask "Where did last month go?"
Choose Open full above the canvas
expected: The panel is one column with the composer docked at the bottom, no brief, notes or starter chips; the compact table fits and any horizontal scrolling stays inside its table block
Open full opens the named space’s /canvas?space=<id> page with March paperwork selected

action: Keep desktop Ask preferences for this tab
user_goal: I want my panel preferences to stay local to my tab and household
preconditions: A fresh workspace and a second household
steps: Run npm run db:ask-routes-test
Check the initial workspace rendering and the panel preference round trip
expected: The initial server-rendered workspace has no panel or view request
At 1200px or wider an absent preference defaults to open; an explicit close stays closed
Preferences contain only the open flag and selected space and are separate by household

action: Keep the Ask composer across workspace navigation
user_goal: I want to see Plan without losing the question I am writing
preconditions: Fresh Ben Try it household at 1440px
steps: Open the Ask panel on Home and type an unsent question
Go to Plan and back
Press Escape
Open the panel again and use Close
expected: The panel keeps the selected space and the draft while navigating
Escape closes the panel and returns focus to the top-bar Ask control
Close also closes the panel while Home stays open

action: Open Ask alongside client details
user_goal: I want to keep the client record in view while I ask a question
preconditions: Fresh Ben Try it household at 1280px
Clients open with Acme’s details selected
steps: Open the Ask panel
Close the panel
expected: The list, selected client details and Ask are visible in that order without sideways scrolling
Acme stays selected after closing the panel

action: Use the current section as Ask context
user_goal: I want Ask to know which screen I’m on from a fixed label
preconditions: An Ask request with the To check screen key
steps: Run npm run db:agent-test
Compare the context with and without the screen field
expected: The screen field adds the fixed sentence The person is asking from To check.
With no screen the context omits that sentence

action: Send only the current section in the screen field
user_goal: I want opening a client record to keep its details out of the screen label
preconditions: Fresh Ben Try it household at 1440px
Clients open with Acme’s details selected
steps: Open the Ask panel and send What’s due this week?
Inspect the screen field in the POST /api/ask payload
Open full Ask, ask again and inspect the same field
expected: The panel sends clients in the screen field
That field contains no client name, row ID, page text or amount
The full page sends canvas in the screen field

action: Submit a money question from Home
user_goal: I want to ask without leaving Home
preconditions: Fresh Ben Try it household on Home at 1440px
Ask panel open on Home
steps: Ask Can I afford ¥4,000 tonight?
expected: The panel shows progress while it works
The answer says ¥4,000 does not fit, quotes ¥0 safe to spend and links to its basis
Home stays at / with the unchanged ¥0 safe to spend and ¥18,780 late-case shortfall on Nov 27

action: Navigate to Plan while an Ask reply is in flight
user_goal: I want to look at Plan while my answer comes in
preconditions: Fresh Ben Try it household on Home at 1440px
Ask panel open on Home
Network log open
steps: Send Can I afford ¥4,000 tonight? once
While Ask is still working, go to Plan and back to Home
Once the reply arrives, go to Plan and back again
expected: The same space stays open and shows one copy of the question and reply
The Network log has one POST /api/ask for the turn

action: Draw a model canvas in the panel
user_goal: I want a what-if canvas to fit next to my current screen
preconditions: Fresh Ben Try it household on Home at 1440px
Ask panel open in the named space March paperwork
steps: Ask What if Northwind pays two weeks late? Show me a what-if canvas.
expected: The compact canvas uses the same amounts as W5 with Northwind delayed 14 days
The canvas fits without sideways scrolling and offers Open full

action: Open a model canvas in full Ask
user_goal: I want to see my answer and its canvas with more room
preconditions: 1440px with the cloud journal and the model canvas from ASKVIEW-015
steps: Choose Open full
expected: The full page opens at /canvas?space=<id> with March paperwork selected
The saved question and its model canvas are present and the separate panel is hidden

action: Attach a fictional bill from the Home panel
user_goal: I want to read a bill while keeping Home open
preconditions: Fresh Ben Try it household on Home at 1440px
Ask panel open on Home
An image of a fictional Kawa Gym bill for ¥6,000 due Dec 12
steps: Choose Attach a bill and select the image
Wait for the reading card
expected: Home stays open while the panel says Reading your bill… and then Read from your bill:
The card shows Kawa Gym, ¥6,000 and Dec 12
Home’s Coming up omits the unconfirmed bill

action: Confirm an attached bill from the panel
user_goal: I want Home to update as soon as I confirm the bill
preconditions: 1440px with the Kawa Gym reading from ASKVIEW-017 open in the Home panel
steps: Answer each reading question and choose Every month if asked whether it repeats
Choose Confirm
Expand Later in the month under Home’s Coming up
expected: The panel says Confirmed. Here is your month with it. and marks Kawa Gym in its canvas timeline
Home stays open and Coming up shows Kawa Gym for ¥6,000 on Dec 12 without manually reloading

action: Request a Keep this? offer from the panel
user_goal: I want to see the preference before it is saved
preconditions: Fresh Ben Try it household on Home at 1440px
Ask panel open on Home
Cloud memory has no matching preference
steps: Ask From now on I prefer short answers about my money. What’s due this week?
Check Memory → Profile in a second tab
expected: The answer offers Keep this? for a Preference with Keep and No
The preference is still absent from Profile before Keep

action: Keep an offered preference from the panel
user_goal: I want to save the preference and stay on Home
preconditions: 1440px with the preference offer from ASKVIEW-019 visible
steps: Choose Keep
Refresh Memory → Profile in the second tab
expected: The panel says Kept. and stays open on Home
Profile shows one preference with the offered words

action: Hide the panel on the full Ask page
user_goal: I want one Ask composer when I open the full page
preconditions: Fresh Ben Try it household on Home at 1440px
Ask panel open on Home
steps: Choose Open full in the Ask panel
Return to Home from the sidebar
expected: Open full shows one question box and no separate Ask panel
On returning to Home the panel is open

user_goal: I want the public sign-in page to have its own layout

Ask panel open on Home
steps: Open /login in the same tab
expected: Sign-in appears without an Ask panel or workspace top bar

action: View the open panel in light and dark
user_goal: I want to read the page and the panel in either appearance
preconditions: Fresh Ben Try it household on Home at 1440px
Ask panel open on Home
steps: Switch between light and dark system appearance
Repeat AQ8 on Clients at 1280px in both appearances
expected: Panel controls, canvas and page text remain readable
Nothing overlaps or scrolls sideways
